substantive_findings: All four Installation smoke platforms (Linux x86-64/ARM64 and macOS Intel/ARM64) reached compiler stage1 == stage2 == stage3 and runtime rt1 == rt2 == rt3, then passed hosted and installed native JIT/AOT output, GC stress, version/commit and external cache checks.

Both Linux Installation jobs passed 53 netio unit tests, hosted and native CPython-oracle parity and pipe-drain checks, plus 300-cycle ASAN/UBSAN ownership checks. macOS ARM native kqueue/pipe parity passed. macOS Intel's netio skips are exactly the workflow's OS conditions.

All three source-provisioning platforms installed from the exact main commit using both pip and uv into isolated directories, checked installed direct_url revision in the helper, exercised provisioned LLVM and JIT/AOT/GC/cache behavior, and uninstalled the command.

Packages ran the native and hosted package smoke. Each built example/port sdists and wheels, verified port source/license/provenance inclusion, used offline hash-locked dependency installation, matched CPython library/module/CLI against JIT and standalone AOT, and rejected an incompatible dependency and altered wheel hash.
The three Installation artifact identities and successful uploads match expected workflow paths; Packages defines no artifact upload and reports zero artifacts.
